description: Move TLS termination from the AWS Application Load Balancer to an Nginx reverse proxy layer for more control over cipher suites and SNI. Must: deploy Nginx with TLS configured (cert-manager for certs), configure dual-termination (ALB + Nginx) during migration, cutover traffic from ALB termination to Nginx termination, verify TLS handshake and certificate chain, and update ALB to TCP passthrough mode. Risk factors: certificate mismatch between ALB and Nginx, SNI routing failure, TLS version incompatibility, cipher suite regression. Tools available: nginx, cert-manager, terraform, aws CLI, openssl.
